provider_patterns.pattern: https://portal.hdontap.com/snapshot/<STREAM> where <STREAM> is the stream= value of a customer embed portal.hdontap.com/s/embed?stream=<STREAM> on the customer's own page
provider_patterns.notes: Worked for 9 streams (City of Del Mar x4, portola_ttv-DMS, ticklepink_ttv-CUST, carlsbad_seashoreonthesand-CUST, hermosa2_swellmagnet-CUST, venice_swellmagnet-CUST); images change between fetches, no Last-Modified, 300x168 to 920x517. HDOnTap's own '-HDOT' ids (portalEmbedId on hdontap.com/stream pages) and many other -CUST ids hang until timeout (use a short timeout). portal robots.txt: Disallow / but Allow /snapshot/. Not a DOT/NPS source. | Verified 2026-09-27: unsuffixed names (e.g. northtahoepud_ttv.stream.jpg, dlvr_svl.stream.jpg, cuyamaca-lake_cam.stream.jpg) update in place every ~5 min, 440x248, Last-Modified present, Cloudflare max-age=120, no referer block (8 used here). Names with a suffix (..._ttv.stream_2p9cYMN.jpg) get a new random suffix on every update and the old name 404s within ~2 min, while the unsuffixed twin of those streams is a frozen 2025 frame, so those streams have no stable still (listed as video_only). Offline streams keep their last frame (Garwoods, 197 h). 202 streams in the map; my parsed western subset (incl. SoCal surf, San Juans, Point Roberts) is lk_hdontap_west.json in the work folder; check each for a suffix. Coordinates are provider-supplied.
current frame JPEG 1280x720-1920x1080, no Last-Modified; verified changing on EMB_DDLQ00000228 and EMB_BJOF0000022D (EMB_SPED0000020A also 200).

provider_patterns.pattern: GET https://manage.hdrelay.com/player/<EMBED_ID> (id from HDRelay.create({id}) on the page) -> JSON camera.id and server.hls; still = https:<server.hls>/camera/<camera.id>/snapshot (also https:<server.jpg>/camera/<camera.id>/get_image?size=800x450)
provider_patterns.notes: Verified on 1 cam only (Santa Cruz Harbor; has Last-Modified). A second camera (Bahia Resort, b10 server from an old aggregator copy) 404'd, so the server host must be re-resolved from the player JSON; pattern not yet confirmed on a 2nd cam. | Second independent confirmation of the coast agent's pattern (Clearly Tahoe, Sand Harbor): 1280x720 with Last-Modified. <server.jpg>/camera/<id>/get_image?size=WxH also works (no Last-Modified). The camera lat/lon in the JSON can be a generic placeholder. | Verified on Port of Brookings (fresh) and Port of Bandon (camera offline, endpoint returns last frame with Last-Modified). The player JS builds this URL as the poster when there is no previewImage; img.hdrelay.com/frames/{camera.id}/default/last.jpg 404s for these video-type cams. Server host moves (b10 -> b15), so resolve from the config each run. Config also gives camera latitude/longitude and status.online.

Resolves embeds of youtube.com/embed/live_stream?channel=... and camstreamer embeds. Reject streams whose _live thumbnail is a custom graphic or frozen (Monterey Bay Aquarium, Venice V Hotel, Pacifica cams showed this). 9 accepted CA frames all changed within 5 min. | isLiveNow:true is not enough: 3 of 4 live streams checked (ABC7 Tahoe, both Seasons at Sandpoint) served a daylight frame after sunset, unchanged over 10-50 min; one (Fresno Reservoir) advanced within 5 min. The builder should also require the hash to change between runs. | HTTPS, not referer-blocked, Cache-Control max-age=300. Frames advanced 6:27 PM -> 6:57 PM over 30 min on 3 live streams (2026-09-27). Caveats: VIDEO_ID changes when a stream restarts; a non-live ID still returns a static _live thumbnail, so the job must check liveness (watch page isLiveNow) and re-resolve IDs; channels with several streams (e.g. KOIN 6) can't use /live. camstreamer.com/embed/<key> pages just wrap a YouTube embed, so they convert the same way. Terms question: YouTube's API/ToS expect thumbnails to link to the video; linking the popup to the watch URL keeps it closest to that. | Lead verified refresh. Extra caveats seen here: a stream with a custom thumbnail returns that static art (Wickaninnish LGbwe4fqzIA); some streams have no maxres (Tofino Sea Kayaking); channel IDs change (Shilshole Xo4TTQy5gXE -> JVTvtCZcSWk). Current ID: fetch https://www.youtube.com/@{handle}/live and read <link rel=canonical href=...watch?v=ID>; liveness: watch page contains "isLiveNow":true.
NOT usable: 403 unless Referer is 805webcams.com (hotlink-locked). Their YouTube streams (channel UCWAerqypqqkyxvy8vskAjrg) were all offline 2026-09-27.

CA ids seen: 286-11-01 (Oakland estuary, used), 286-05-01 (Emeryville, mostly I-80 freeway), 281-02-01 (Santa Monica pier amusements), 286-06-01 and 281-06-01 404. | Confirmed on 162-02-01 (Coeur d'Alene, Hagadone): 672x378, fresh Last-Modified. current.jpg under images.repo is 404. ID is in api.wetmet.net PlayerFrame.php?CAMERA=<ID>. | Found on one cam (Narrows Marina, Tacoma): 448x252, fresh Last-Modified. Not yet confirmed on a second Wetmet cam; wetmet.net itself did not respond.

CA NAMEs: islandpalms1 (used), westland (Venice boardwalk, not water), pl (live6; Phil's BBQ interior - reject; live6.brownrice.com/cam-images/pl.jpg also works with Last-Modified). | NAMEs seen: mckinleybeach (live5 cam-images, Last-Modified), mckinleymarina, lakegreg1 (via 590804fbbbc47.streamlock.net), mountainwestcxp (via 5b8462eb3469a.streamlock.net; overlay dated 2012, frozen), welhomeshop1 (live4 cam-images OK), communityinktahoesouth, suteosprey1, predatorridge, predatorridgeptz. communityinklaketahoehwy50 returns the 200 PNG 'scheduled to be offline' card. | Brownrice's own site uses this as each camera's 'Still'. Sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and no Last-Modified. Verified on washougalmarina, westland, bellingham2/3/5, semiahmoo1, jscaptz. liveN.brownrice.com/cam-images/NAME.jpg works only for some servers (live6 yes; live1/live3/live5 no), so use snapshot/. Offline cams return 200 with a PNG 'scheduled to be offline' card: treat an image/png response as offline.

Verified on 12 images 2026-09-27, 980x551, Last-Modified present, referer OK. Some frames frozen for months (scenic23 Nelson June, scenic29 Eldorado Aug), so check Last-Modified. The index also lists third-party stills (Brownrice, apps.kelowna.ca, NAV Canada, Sun Peaks).

provider_patterns.pattern: https://tripcheck.com/RoadCams/cams/<filename>  with filename, title and lat/lon from https://tripcheck.com/Scripts/map/data/cctvinventory.js
provider_patterns.notes: Inventory is public ArcGIS-style JSON. Non-highway entries have route 'City'/'CNTY' and include the USCG bar cams. When a feed is down TripCheck serves a 'currently unavailable' placeholder with a fresh Last-Modified, so staleness must be read from the image, not the header.

provider_patterns.pattern: https://camstreamer.com/embed/{id} or /yt-embed/{a}/{S-n} -> HTTP 302 to https://www.youtube.com/embed/{VIDEO_ID}; then https://i.ytimg.com/vi/{VIDEO_ID}/maxresdefault_live.jpg
provider_patterns.notes: Verified on White Rock x2, RVYC x2, Ocean Village Tofino. Lets the builder follow a stream restart without scraping YouTube. Camstreamer-hosted (non-YouTube) embeds that were offline returned a 690-byte 'no signal' page (Zuanich Point, Orcas Island YC).

webcamId is the 'e' value in timelapseview_options[...] = {e:..., t:...} on the embedding page (widget id i=gZmtA is NOT the webcam id). Built from widget-v1_03.js. Verified here on one cam (Sail Sand Point); the providers folder shows webcam.io/w/yz7Yp9/latest.jpg for another.

Poster URL from the per-customer //pixelcaster.com/live/{customer}/pixelcaster.js; prefix 'dn' is customer-specific (Delaware North). One cam verified; read the customer's pixelcaster.js for the exact prefix.
From the camera's /viewer/live/wv.js; identifies Canon viewers at /viewer/live/index.html. Usually http-only raw IPs. One cam verified.
The share.ambientweather.net/share/v/{base64} link decodes to JSON naming this image. Fresh (Last-Modified). Verified on one cam (Depoe Bay area; view was mostly trees so not listed).
